answer: Proof of Burn serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism where agents destroy native tokens to gain consensus weight. If an attacker attempts to flood the network with fake nodes, their capital efficiency reaches a nadir, rendering the exploit unfeasible. This sacrifice ensures the nectar of network incentives is reserved for honest actors. By binding identity to a jade scarcity model, the protocol imposes a linear cost on creation, nullifying the marginal advantage of automated registration.
